name: Reactive Two-Point Start Sprint
setup: Split stance behind the cone, front foot just behind it, weight forward.
cues: Go on a point or a call from a partner, not on your own count.
Push the ground back behind you.
Lean into the run like you are falling forward, then catch yourself.

faults.fault: Standing straight up in the first steps
faults.fix: Stay low and push the ground back for the first five steps.
Strike the ground under you, not out in front.

cautions: Full warm-up first; stop the set when the speed drops.

Push the ground back behind you.

faults.fault: Standing straight up in the first steps

Strike the ground under you, not out in front.

cautions: Full warm-up first; stop the set when the speed drops.

name: Reactive Decel to Stick
setup: Two cones 10 metres apart; run from the first toward the second.
cues: Go on a point or a call from a partner, not on your own count.
Short, choppy steps as the cone arrives.
Sink the hips toward the floor and stick the stop at the cone.

faults.fault: Stopping with one long braking step
faults.fix: Chop the feet: three short steps into the stop at the cone.

faults.fault: Knees caving in on the stop
faults.fix: Stop with the knees out over your laces and the hips low.

name: Reactive Lateral Shuffle
setup: Two cones 5 metres apart; start in a low athletic stance at one.
cues: Go on a point or a call from a partner, not on your own count.
Push the floor away sideways with the trailing foot.
Keep the hips low and level, like under a low ceiling.

faults.fix: Stay under the low ceiling: the head travels flat.
Keep a gap between the shoes the whole way.

name: Cone Weave Against the Clock
setup: Six cones in a zig-zag, 3 metres apart.
cues: Count clean reps in the time; a rep that is not clean does not count.
Weave through the cones, planting the outside foot close to each cone.
Sink the hips toward the floor before every cut.

faults.fix: Lower the hips toward the floor a step before the cone.
Plant the outside foot close to the cone and push the ground back.

cautions: Full warm-up first; stop the set when the speed drops.

name: Ladder One Foot In Against the Clock
setup: An agility ladder flat on the floor; start at one end.

Stay on the balls of the feet, quiet on the floor.
